objects.name: Attackers Abuse ChatGPT Custom GPTs to Deploy a Full-Featured RAT
objects.description: Threat actors abused fake ChatGPT Custom GPTs and ClickFix to deliver a multi-stage RAT. ChatGPT’s Custom GPT feature is the latest legitimate surface being turned into a delivery mechanism, and Huntress researchers caught it in action across at least 40 incidents.
